methodologyNote: Measured via search host referrals in tracked traffic.

aiSummary: In October 2026, Google google.com led search engine hosts (desktop) in Australia at 73.81% (market share of tracked page views / usage). bing bing.com ranked second at 19.77%, followed by Yahoo! au.search.yahoo.com at 2.46%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engine hosts (desktop) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Google google.com leads at 73.81% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-host-market-share/desktop/australia.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engine hosts (desktop) in Australia?
faqs.answer: Google google.com (73.81%), bing bing.com (19.77%), Yahoo! au.search.yahoo.com (2.46%) in October 2026.
